name: map-panel-shell
title: Map panel shell
description: A full-bleed map or any view with a floating search and results panel that becomes a bottom sheet with three snap heights on phones.
docs: Pass canvas (your map: Leaflet, Mapbox, MapLibre, an image, a floor plan; the block draws nothing and loads nothing), panel (the results list), and optionally search, filters and controls. From 48rem of width the panel floats at the start (the left) as a 24rem card, with a tab on its edge that hides it and a Show results button that brings it back; controls sit in the opposite corner, and the layout follows dir="rtl". Below that it is a bottom sheet with three snap heights: peek (the search only), half and full (a strip of the map stays above it, and the controls fold away until the sheet is lowered). Move it by dragging the handle, with ArrowUp and ArrowDown, Home and End on the handle, by tapping the handle, or with the button beside the search. The sheet is not modal: nothing dims the map, nothing traps focus, and the map keeps taking input around it. In the tab order the panel comes first, then the controls, then your map. At peek the filters and the list step out of the tab order, and focusing the search lifts the sheet to half. open and onOpenChange control whether the panel is shown; snap and onSnapChange control the sheet's height (defaultOpen and defaultSnap leave it to the shell). The search slot sits in a 2.25rem row, which is what peek shows. The filters wrap onto more rows on the card and scroll sideways on a phone, with a fade at the end that has more to see; give every chip an icon, as a selected chip swaps it for a check, so selecting never changes its width. The shell is as tall as its container: it is h-dvh unless you pass a height in className.
